title: india_lp Institutional Actor Record
description: An institution, agency, office, board, or role relevant to India's curriculum-policy process -- a ministry, an autonomous statutory body, a state education board, a state textbook board, a research institute. Not a person-tracking record: named individuals may appear in `currentHolder` but the record is anchored to the institutional role, which outlives any one office-holder. Modeled directly on deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's institutional-actor-record.schema.json -- same shape, actorType vocabulary adapted to India's own institutional landscape, which does not map cleanly onto either Germany's ministry-centric or New York's single-board model: India's two central curriculum bodies (NCERT, CBSE) are legally autonomous societies registered under the Societies Registration Act 1860, not government departments themselves, and states run their own textbook/curriculum boards with real, documented variation in how they license their output (see docs/source-notes/2026-09-30-india-curriculum-licensing-landscape-research.md) -- actorType distinguishes 'autonomous-statutory-body' and 'state-textbook-board' from 'ministry' specifically so that legal-form distinction, which matters for the copyright questions this repo exists to track, stays visible rather than flattened.

id.description: Provisional, repo-local id. See GOVERNANCE.md -- not an ecosystem-permanent identifier.

actorType.description: 'ministry' = a literal Government of India or state government department (e.g. Ministry of Education). 'autonomous-statutory-body' = a body registered under the Societies Registration Act 1860 or a similar act, government-funded/controlled but not itself a government department -- NCERT and CBSE are both this, a distinction that matters directly for whether Copyright Act 1957 Section 2(k)'s 'government work' definition applies to their output (open legal question, see the source-notes doc). 'state-education-board' = a state's curriculum-setting authority generally. 'state-textbook-board' = a state's specific textbook-publishing corporation/bureau (e.g. Maharashtra's Balbharati, Tamil Nadu's TNTBESC), called out separately from state-education-board because licensing terms have been found to vary at exactly this level (Karnataka's DSERT/KOER is CC BY-SA 4.0; Maharashtra's Balbharati is fee-gated and restrictive).

jurisdiction.description: ISO-3166-2 style state code (e.g. IN-KA for Karnataka, IN-MH for Maharashtra) or 'IN' for national/central-government scope.

parentActor.description: Id of the actor this one reports into, is a division of, or was constituted by, if any.

role.description: What this actor does with respect to curriculum policy specifically -- not a general institutional mission statement.

legalForm.description: Free text, kept separate from actorType's coarser category, for the specific legal basis when known and relevant to a rights/licensing question -- e.g. 'registered society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 (Act XXI)', 'body corporate established under a State Act'. Optional; fill in only when this repo has an actual citable source for it, not a guess.

currentHolder.description: Named individual currently in this role, if applicable and known. Titles/incumbents change -- always check verificationStatus before treating this as current.
